title: In repos/relevance-sink-vessel/src/index.ts, region: the `if (req.method === "GET" && url.pathname === "/health")` block
description: In repos/relevance-sink-vessel/src/index.ts, region: the `if (req.method === "GET" && url.pathname === "/health")` block inside Bun.serve's fetch handler (currently returns Response.json({ status: "ok", vessel: "relevance-sink-vessel" }) unconditionally). Change this block so it first verifies the SurrealDB dependency: await a fetch POST to `${SURREALDB_URL}/sql` with body `RETURN 1;` and headers Accept: application/json, surreal-ns: SURREALDB_NAMESPACE, surreal-db: SURREALDB_DATABASE, Authorization: basicAuth(SURREALDB_USERNAME, SURREALDB_PASSWORD) — the same header set applyPenalty builds — wrapped in a try/catch with AbortSignal.timeout(2000). If the response is ok, return the existing 200 body. If the fetch throws or the response is not ok, return Response.json({ status: "degraded", vessel: "relevance-sink-vessel", store: "unreachable" }, { status: 503 }). Reason: health currently reports ok while every write fails ConnectionRefused, so a miswired deployment passes every automatic check (proven 2026-09-15, validation/reports/wiring-green-vs-miswired-proof).
